verdict.rationale: The pack documents a unified, OpenAI-compatible API across many providers (docs-20, docs-26, docs-51), but nothing mentions tool or function calling, or a normalized tool schema across providers. The remote-MCP connection feature (docs-17) is a different capability and does not show consistent function-calling schemas. Because a unified API layer on its own does not prove tool calls are normalized, the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema
